name: domain.loop_engine
description: Goal-directed agent loop state machine with tri-state resource polling, decision fixtures, stepwise control, and checkpoint persistence

entrypoints.name: run_loop
entrypoints.description: Execute a goal-directed task DAG loop with tri-state polling, decision recovery, and branch deadlock isolation

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: List of task definitions with task_id, depends_on, requires_resource, and requires_decision

parameters.name: eventually_available_resources
parameters.description: Dictionary mapping resource keys to polling attempts required before availability

entrypoints.name: step_loop
entrypoints.description: Execute a single iteration step on an existing loop checkpoint, optionally injecting dynamic tasks

parameters.name: context
parameters.description: Context variables to supply or update

parameters.name: new_tasks
parameters.description: Optional list of dynamic tasks to inject before the step

entrypoints.name: export_loop_checkpoint
entrypoints.description: Initialize and export a pristine loop state checkpoint without running it

parameters.name: eventually_available_resources
parameters.description: Dictionary mapping resource keys to polling attempts required

entrypoints.name: validate_task_dag
entrypoints.description: Validate task DAG for cyclic dependencies, missing task IDs, and structural correctness

parameters.name: tasks
parameters.description: List of task definitions to validate

entrypoints.name: benchmark_loop_vs_linear
entrypoints.description: Benchmark goal-directed LoopController against one-shot linear baseline across failure topologies

parameters.name: num_scenarios
parameters.description: Number of seeded scenarios to evaluate (default: 10)

entrypoints.name: create_scenario_graph
entrypoints.description: Generate a synthetic task graph scenario with controlled failure and latency injection

parameters.name: tasks_per_branch
parameters.description: Number of sequential tasks per branch (default: 3)

parameters.name: failure_mix
parameters.description: Custom probability weights for failure modes
